paper_title: A quantum-enhanced search for dark matter axions
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from the paper's quoted g_gamma = 1.38 x g_gamma^KSVZ using g_agamma = (alpha/pi) g_gamma / f_a with m_a f_a = 5.7 ueV x 1e12 GeV and |g_gamma^KSVZ| = 0.97
notes: HAYSTAC quantum-enhanced (squeezed state receiver) haloscope search. Excludes axions with g_gamma >= 1.38 x g_gamma^KSVZ at 90% CL over 16.96-17.12 and 17.14-17.28 ueV (4.100-4.140 and 4.145-4.178 GHz). The limit is flat in units of g_gamma/g_KSVZ; converted to absolute g_agamma [GeV^-1], which scales linearly with mass along the KSVZ line. Four points mark the endpoints of the two mass windows (small gap at ~17.13 ueV due to a TE mode intruder). DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is the standard HAYSTAC assumption (not explicitly restated in this letter).
